answer: The Documentation page passing automated tests backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Like a grove in a workshop, one odd piece hides easily, so the check runs on every submission rather than a sample. Whether the proof comes from a willow or a tide, the verification step is identical and public.
